guitar.evidence: David Gilmour's "Black Strat" Fender Stratocaster is one of the most famous and well-documented guitars in rock history.

tone.target: clean arpeggiated Gilmour with tape delay and phaser swirl
tone.profile: clean arpeggiated Gilmour with tape delay and phaser swirl
tone.summary: A classic Gilmour-esque setup utilizing a clean Fender-style amp model (US Deluxe) paired with gentle compression, phaser modulation, and short slapback/plate reverb for spacious arpeggios.
corrections: delay is short repeats not long ambient

rig.name: Pink Floyd - Brain Damage _ Eclipse - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and hum.
Smooth dynamics and sustain for arpeggios.
Simulate the subtle 'swirl' of a phaser/phaser effect without sounding like chorus wash.
blocks.gap: The GP-180 lacks a dedicated Phaser module. Chorus is used as the closest substitute for gentle, swirling modulation.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone pristine and clean.
Provide high clean headroom and a classic Fender/Hiwatt-like tone.
Match the clean, articulate sound of a Fender-style rig.
Slight tonal shaping to enhance clarity and definition in the arpeggios.
Achieve the short, rhythmic repeats reminiscent of Binson Echorec.
Add spaciousness and atmosphere without sounding muddy.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism and tonal depth to better capture the spacious, articulate sound required for Gilmour's arpeggios.

proposals.reason: The current US 2x12 is too bright; a warmer, more complex cabinet will add depth.
